title: Power Rankings: Introducing the Super Six ... and the Other 24
heading: 2005-06 Power Rankings: Week 22

rankings.summaryHtml: Beating Heat, Mavs and Suns in relatively quick succession takes Pistons to 9-4 against the rest of the top six ... and takes them back to No. 1.
rankings.summaryText: Beating Heat, Mavs and Suns in relatively quick succession takes Pistons to 9-4 against the rest of the top six ... and takes them back to No. 1.

rankings.summaryHtml: Maybe he is feeling better: Duncan has scored 20 or more points in seven of the past 11 games. Before that? Just four times in all of 2006.
rankings.summaryText: Maybe he is feeling better: Duncan has scored 20 or more points in seven of the past 11 games. Before that? Just four times in all of 2006.

rankings.summaryHtml: Just a hunch: If Nets keep holding teams to 81 ppg, as they have been during their 12-game unbeaten run, this is going to wind up being bigger than a hot streak.
rankings.summaryText: Just a hunch: If Nets keep holding teams to 81 ppg, as they have been during their 12-game unbeaten run, this is going to wind up being bigger than a hot streak.

rankings.summaryHtml: Van Horn's broken hand means he's likely lost for the year. A 10-8 malaise means No. 1 in the West is looking all but lost as well for banged-up Mavs.
rankings.summaryText: Van Horn's broken hand means he's likely lost for the year. A 10-8 malaise means No. 1 in the West is looking all but lost as well for banged-up Mavs.

rankings.summaryHtml: Suns are just 7-7 since that 11-game win streak. But it's not as if they're going to panic now, remembering how they recovered from a 4-5 start.
rankings.summaryText: Suns are just 7-7 since that 11-game win streak. But it's not as if they're going to panic now, remembering how they recovered from a 4-5 start.

rankings.summaryHtml: Thursday vs. Detroit is Heat's last chance to wow us before the playoffs. Sunday's loss to Nets dropped Miami to 2-11 against the committee's top five.
rankings.summaryText: Thursday vs. Detroit is Heat's last chance to wow us before the playoffs. Sunday's loss to Nets dropped Miami to 2-11 against the committee's top five.

rankings.summaryHtml: Don't know whether surging Cavs have the gas for a 6-3 finish ... but if LeBron can get them to 50 wins, he might just force himself into the MVP reckoning.
rankings.summaryText: Don't know whether surging Cavs have the gas for a 6-3 finish ... but if LeBron can get them to 50 wins, he might just force himself into the MVP reckoning.

rankings.summaryHtml: The bad news? Nuggets are just 4-8 against the West's top three. The good news: They're also on the verge of the franchise's first division title since (gasp) 1988.
rankings.summaryText: The bad news? Nuggets are just 4-8 against the West's top three. The good news: They're also on the verge of the franchise's first division title since (gasp) 1988.

rankings.summaryHtml: Only 10 games left, but we'll see Clips in potential playoff previews against both teams -- Denver once and Dallas twice -- they can be matched up with in Round 1.
rankings.summaryText: Only 10 games left, but we'll see Clips in potential playoff previews against both teams -- Denver once and Dallas twice -- they can be matched up with in Round 1.

rankings.summaryHtml: Want more evidence that there's more to Pau's game than ever? The bearded Spaniard averaged almost six assists a game in March.
rankings.summaryText: Want more evidence that there's more to Pau's game than ever? The bearded Spaniard averaged almost six assists a game in March.

rankings.summaryHtml: What a difference a Zenmeister makes? Last season's Lakers went 8-24 after the All-Star break. These Lakers are 14-9 and sure to finish over .500 now.
rankings.summaryText: What a difference a Zenmeister makes? Last season's Lakers went 8-24 after the All-Star break. These Lakers are 14-9 and sure to finish over .500 now.

rankings.summaryHtml: Wiz couldn't quite pull off a season sweep of Spurs, but a 3-3 trip out West -- painful as the last two games were -- keeps them in the lead for the No. 5 seed.
rankings.summaryText: Wiz couldn't quite pull off a season sweep of Spurs, but a 3-3 trip out West -- painful as the last two games were -- keeps them in the lead for the No. 5 seed.

rankings.summaryHtml: Turning that 15-zip start at Detroit into a win would have made it Bucks' best week of the season. But it was still pretty good, with wins over Suns and Pacers.
rankings.summaryText: Turning that 15-zip start at Detroit into a win would have made it Bucks' best week of the season. But it was still pretty good, with wins over Suns and Pacers.

rankings.summaryHtml: Hate to spoil the mood, but the West's supposed spoilers are 5-5 since a 7-1 start to March and 21-12 since the Artest trade. In other words: good, but not yet fearsome.
rankings.summaryText: Hate to spoil the mood, but the West's supposed spoilers are 5-5 since a 7-1 start to March and 21-12 since the Artest trade. In other words: good, but not yet fearsome.

rankings.summaryHtml: Here's something no one can blame on Artest: Indy is an unforgivable 0-9 against Hawks, Raps and Celts, which is far worse than its current 6-12 slide.
rankings.summaryText: Here's something no one can blame on Artest: Indy is an unforgivable 0-9 against Hawks, Raps and Celts, which is far worse than its current 6-12 slide.

rankings.summaryHtml: Since that March 5 home collapse vs. Indy, Sixers are 4-9. What's left of Philly's lead goes if it can't win at least one of this week's two Sixers-Bulls ''showdowns.''
rankings.summaryText: Since that March 5 home collapse vs. Indy, Sixers are 4-9. What's left of Philly's lead goes if it can't win at least one of this week's two Sixers-Bulls ''showdowns.''

rankings.summaryHtml: Bulls began their latest playoff ''push'' with a home loss last Tuesday to Orlando, but they sure picked the right race to be in because Philly keeps giving Chicago life.
rankings.summaryText: Bulls began their latest playoff ''push'' with a home loss last Tuesday to Orlando, but they sure picked the right race to be in because Philly keeps giving Chicago life.

rankings.summaryHtml: Lord Byron's honesty isn't remembered fondly in Jersey, but it's working with Hornets, who are 3-0 since he said lots of them ''just quit'' in a rout at Utah.
rankings.summaryText: Lord Byron's honesty isn't remembered fondly in Jersey, but it's working with Hornets, who are 3-0 since he said lots of them ''just quit'' in a rout at Utah.

rankings.summaryHtml: AK-47 found a good way to get us to stop talking about his spouse, averaging five blocks in the past seven games to go with 18.9 ppg, 10.3 rpg and 4.6 apg.
rankings.summaryText: AK-47 found a good way to get us to stop talking about his spouse, averaging five blocks in the past seven games to go with 18.9 ppg, 10.3 rpg and 4.6 apg.

rankings.summaryHtml: Brian Hill insists that his Magic are still in the playoff hunt. As limp as Sixers and Bulls look, it might not even be an exaggeration.

rankings.summaryHtml: Almost no one knows Rockets' future GM, but Daryl Morey did attend Northwestern and MIT. Which, if nothing else, leads to an obvious nickname: Rocket Scientist.

rankings.summaryHtml: Tough times: Wilcox averages a mere 14 and 6 in the five games after his two-game eruption ... and Hollinger brands Sonics ''worst defensive team ever.''

rankings.summaryHtml: It's not an easy East for everybody: Since Pierce told his teammates they'd need a 15-6 finish to reach the playoffs, Celts are 4-8.
rankings.summaryText: It's not an easy East for everybody: Since Pierce told his teammates they'd need a 15-6 finish to reach the playoffs, Celts are 4-8.

rankings.summaryHtml: The other drama for KG's Wolves? Every loss increases their odds of landing a top-10 pick. If it's lower than No. 10, it goes to Clippers (gulp) as part of the Cassell deal.
rankings.summaryText: The other drama for KG's Wolves? Every loss increases their odds of landing a top-10 pick. If it's lower than No. 10, it goes to Clippers (gulp) as part of the Cassell deal.

rankings.summaryHtml: So how do Warriors follow up road wins over Dallas and Sacto and 10-spot rise I'd like to take back? With a four-game losing streak, three of the losses at home.

rankings.summaryHtml: Thank you, Toronto. The committee (of one) is touched to report that we haven't received one e-mail attacking our man Pape for the Bosh injury.

rankings.summaryHtml: Hawks, I'm told, already have called the league office to make the request: More than four games against Indiana next season, please!

rankings.summaryHtml: The difference between Bobcats and the two teams below? Charlotte is still trying, as evidenced by the sudden release of Kareem Rush for not working hard enough.

rankings.summaryHtml: No matter how bad it gets, ESPN research ace Michael Jackson always wants to talk Knicks. Which always makes me wonder: Do Knicks care as much as he does?
